Greg's decision, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #760, 2026-10-14 00:10:59Z; recorded by Termal::Fable2): "Greg's earlier direct decision resolves w-aab0 option A/B: use B, automatic Resume for a capacity-paused session, with minute-scale backoff 2 min, then 5 min, then 10 min (not second-scale retries). Keep unknown delivery/manual-reconciliation cases manual; do not replay an uncertain request. Record the precise retry ceiling/terminal behavior in the item, consistent with the existing recommended bounded policy, and proceed with implementation under normal gates."

Item: w-aab0b16aca1b, criteria revision 2: 8 attempts (2, 5, then 10 min each, about 67 min in total), ±20% jitter, terminal state "Paused: provider at capacity, retries exhausted…; Resume to retry". Holder Sol-edfd (session-12328) proposes any option-B wording change, and Fable2 concurs before the revise.
